method: Actual app.js evaluated in Node VM with minimal DOM, accelerated timers, AbortSignal-aware transport/body faults, persistent tab storage and an idempotent session mock. Tests frontend state transitions; separate HTTP and browser tests cover their respective layers.

checks.scenario: Connection absent before POST: no charge; manual recovery reuses request and session
Response lost after settlement: retry displays the original round and never charges twice
Transient HTTP 408: autoplay retries the same ID and completes all 10 rounds
Transient HTTP 429: autoplay retries the same ID and completes all 10 rounds
Transient HTTP 500: autoplay retries the same ID and completes all 10 rounds
Transient HTTP 502: autoplay retries the same ID and completes all 10 rounds
Transient HTTP 503: autoplay retries the same ID and completes all 10 rounds
Persistent network-before: exactly 3 attempts, explicit stop, pending retained, manual recovery
Persistent lost-response: exactly 3 attempts, explicit stop, pending retained, manual recovery
Persistent http-429: exactly 3 attempts, explicit stop, pending retained, manual recovery
Persistent http-502: exactly 3 attempts, explicit stop, pending retained, manual recovery
fetch-stall: 15-second deadline covers transport and response body, then safe recovery
body-stall: 15-second deadline covers transport and response body, then safe recovery
Persistent transport stalls: autoplay stops after 3 timeouts without any charge
session_expired: terminal recovery error stops old-session play without a charge
session_changed: terminal recovery error stops old-session play without a charge
result_expired: terminal recovery error stops old-session play without a charge
Double-click while a response is delayed: busy guard sends exactly one request
Connection disappears after bonus result arrives: finish all 8 free spins, stop on next paid request
bad-json: rejected before clearing pending or presenting a result; exact recovery
empty-json: rejected before clearing pending or presenting a result; exact recovery
wrong-request-id: rejected before clearing pending or presenting a result; exact recovery
wrong-session-id: rejected before clearing pending or presenting a result; exact recovery
wrong-version: rejected before clearing pending or presenting a result; exact recovery
Slow response below deadline: one round and one request, without retries
Late response beyond deadline: timeout retains original ID, retry does not double-charge
Page reload with settled but unread response: recover saved request without duplicate history
Reload after autoplay round 81 outage: recover 81/100 and keep autoplay stopped
Reload after server session replacement: stale pending never executes in the new session
Symbol manifest stalls during startup: initialization ends at its 15-second deadline
